🎬 The Heartbreak Kid (2007)

The Heartbreak Kid follows Eddie Cantrow, a forty-year-old bachelor who begins questioning his single lifestyle after watching his former fiancée get married. When he meets Lila, a beautiful and seemingly perfect woman, Eddie quickly falls in love and impulsively decides to marry her after only a few weeks of dating. However, during their honeymoon in Mexico, he discovers that his new wife is completely different from the person he thought he knew. As their romantic getaway turns into a hilarious nightmare, Eddie meets Miranda, a charming and down-to-earth woman with whom he develops a genuine connection. Desperate to pursue his newfound feelings while hiding his marriage, Eddie finds himself trapped in a complicated web of lies, awkward encounters, and ridiculous misunderstandings. Starring Ben Stiller, Malin Åkerman, and Michelle Monaghan, the film delivers outrageous comedy and entertaining storytelling about impulsive decisions, romantic expectations, commitment, and the unpredictable consequences of searching for true love.

🎭 Genre: Romantic Comedy • Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 5.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 56m • R

🎥 Directors: Bobby Farrelly & Peter Farrelly

📚 Based On: A remake of the 1972 film The Heartbreak Kid, directed by Elaine May.

📍 Setting: San Francisco, California, and Cabo San Lucas, Mexico.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Paramount+ for current streaming, rental, or purchase availability in the United States.
